overview: BRF is a premium multi-tenant SaaS platform for local service businesses delivering AI-powered front desk, CRM, reputation management, SEO audit, fundability builder, lead generation, AI chat and voice agents, automated review flows, analytics, newsletter management, and a dual-sided campaigns module — all on the Internet Computer Protocol.
features: AI-powered inbound voice agent with ElevenLabs voices
Full CRM with Kanban pipeline and calendar sync
Newsletter module with subscriber management, campaign composer, merge tags, scheduling, and analytics
Outreach engine with bounce handling, lead segmentation, throttling controls, and analytics dashboard
Automated B2B lead discovery and drip campaigns
Reputation management with automated review requests
Business credit builder and fundability scoring
White-label agency support with branded dashboards
Multi-tenant role-based access (Super Admin, Agency, Client, Demo)
Social media publishing and engagement automation
Go Live credential dashboard with 25+ integrations
